criteria.evidence: Recommends a single Python app/loop, one LLM via the anthropic SDK (openai as alternate), and imports the two existing functions directly with a registry; 'Nothing else to start with.'

criteria.evidence: Architecture section: LLM interprets and decides; app validates args, runs functions, handles errors, caps steps. Code uses REGISTRY allowlist and app-run execution; notes not to rely on the model's decision as permission.
criteria.criterion: Separate LLM decisions from application execution and orchestration.

criteria.evidence: Code appends assistant content, executes tool_use blocks, builds tool_result with tool_use_id and is_error, appends as user message, loops until stop_reason != tool_use, returns final text.

'What to skip (for now)' lists LangChain, MCP, vector DBs, multi-agent; add only when a concrete gap like document search, persistent memory, or shared tools arises. Confirmation prompt only if side effects.
